source_admission: Published values used in run.py and README.md through the project's products, plus one review read for this study; no external dataset files are admitted. 'access' records how far each source was checked on 2026-10-09: 'publisher page' means the article's page was fetched and its passages summarized by a fetch tool, with the quoted passages checked against it; 'reported in' names the project register whose search or reading admitted it, not re-read here. Project products are cited by path in the README and hashed in results/ways_of_living.json.
